stories.title: Pupils help clean up Ewloe as part of Mini Police scheme
stories.summary: Two large bin bags of rubbish, and a toaster, were pulled from a duck pond in Ewloe last week. Year 5 pupils from Ysgol Penarlag found the rubbish while taking part in North Wales Police’s Mini Police scheme. stories.title: Police warn against swimming and off road biking at Flintshire Quarry
stories.summary: North Wales Police has warned people to stay away from Pant Quarry in Halkyn, after a high number of calls about off road bikes and swimmers at the site. stories.title: North Wales Police warns of fake bank call and WhatsApp scam
stories.summary: North Wales Police has warned people not to share bank details after a scam involving fake fraud calls followed by WhatsApp messages. The force’s Cyber Crime Team said fraudsters are phoning victims claiming to be from their bank’s fraud team. stories.title: North Wales force’s handling of rural crime and emergency calls examined by PCC
stories.summary: North Wales Police’s handling of rural crime and how quickly officers respond to emergency calls faced scrutiny at the force’s latest Strategic Executive Board meeting. Police and Crime Commissioner Andy Dunbobbin held the session with Chief Constable Amanda Blakeman KPM and other senior officers. stories.title: 37% of Wales coastguards may cut hours over pay changes, GMB survey finds
stories.summary: More than 350 coastguards across Wales responded to a survey which found 37 per cent would be forced to reduce their hours or stop volunteering if planned pay cuts go ahead.
